schema_limitations: JSON Schema integer permits numerically integral float tokens: strict JSON parser must reject floats before schema validation.
UTF-8 and total canonical body bounds are runtime checks, not standard JSON Schema keywords.
UUID shape does not establish project ownership.
Source/provenance and status fields are response-only server assertions, never mutation input.
Recent reauthentication, CSRF, Origin, session/epoch, expiry, exact canonical payload hash, one-use approval and atomic deletion cannot be established by shape validation.
Headers schema describes one application header; HTTP parser must reject duplicate Idempotency-Key headers.
Delete preparation snapshot consistency and stale/deleted replay suppression require runtime database checks.
